newsitem.title: USA: INSTANT VIEW -U.S. stocks seen off after jobs data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -U.S. stocks seen off after jobs data.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to open lower on Friday following the release of U.S. employment data which showed U.S. May nonfarm payrolls rose 138,000.
The following are some analyst reactions:
Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co said:
"The unemployment number is the lowest we've seen in quite some time, so it could dampen some of the recent enthusiasm we've seen in the stock market."
